title: naboer 0.1.0
text: Added cross-validation folds separate assessment omission membership, validation, diagnostics, tibble views plots. Designs export complete nei structures mgcv NCV/QNCV, including optional neighbourhood sampling covariance settings. Compatibility checks require least two folds explicit sampled fold numbers nonsingleton omissions tested mgcv 1.9-4 integration. Added spatial, temporal spatiotemporal neighbourhoods block designs, asymmetric elapsed/calendar/count windows, buffers rolling-origin forecasts across multiple series independent domains. Shared forecasting cutoffs exclude future observations across dependent series; calendar shifts preserve zero-width instants use index time zone. Added grouped hierarchical holdouts, environmental clustering strata, phylogenetic distance neighbourhoods clade/cluster holdouts, faithful rsample import/export preserved key/domain metadata guarded analysis expansion. Imports require resamples indexing individual observations. Added optional sf, tsibble cubble adapters, indexed spatial queries, compressed interval storage, allocation guards reproducible R benchmarks. Explicit spatial grid anchors remain stable across data subsets, radius queries consistently use stored coordinates. approximation study includes large-omission stress tests independent weighted Gaussian refits.
